abstract: It should be a leading university for Social Development. Today, in the new wave of the industrial revolution, the impact of the social “run” of the university is not a small number, some still can not keep up. And why is that? The author think the reasons are as follows: The concept of education is relatively lagging behind, the education model is unchanged, and it can not keep up with the times. It is especially reflected in many problems such as inaccurate target positioning, backward practical education links, inadequate industry connection, and fuzzy professional integration. In response to these problems, the author put forward some improvement measures and constructive suggestions to the reader.

articleTitle: The Power Consumption Analysis of Java Card on Different Cryptographic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: More java cards will be used in 5G network applications in the form of eSim. China's 5G technology will use both SM cryptographic algorithm and the international traditional algorithm. It is particularly important to compare the difference between the SM algorithm and the traditional algorithm in power consumption. In the paper, the power consumption is analyzed and compared between SM2, SM3, SM4 and RSA, SHA-256, DES, AES through measurement method. The difference and advantage between them is evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on image recognition algorithm of Agricultural products based on edge calculation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of agricultural product image recognition is studied. Due to the difficulty and time consuming in human eye identification of agricultural product image recognition, an algorithm of agricultural product image recognition based on edge calculation is proposed, which can be applied to the problem of agricultural product image recognition in traceability. Firstly, the advantages of edge calculation and image feature extraction methods are analyzed, and the layered discriminant analysis algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the layered discriminant analysis algorithm has high image recognition accuracy, reduces the response time of image recognition, and has better flexibility and practicability.

articleTitle: Experiment of Sentiment Analysis on Public Comments of Hot Topics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet, the public can get news from the recent hottest news, and express their opinion in time in the network of social media, such as microblog, twitter. With the help of sentiment analysis of the comments, the government or the media can inform of the public opinion, and make corresponding decisions, so that they are able to get the positive feedback. Also, the sentiment analysis can help people block the detrimental comments. Since the sentiment analysis is useful in the daily life, the author made an experiment about the sentiment analysis of three models, namely, Naive Byes, Maximum Entropy, and SVM, to compare the results' accuracy of them. And the dataset used in this experiment is Stanford Twitter Sentiment (STS). Besides, the reference is made to Stanford Sentiment Treebank and IMDB. In addition, the determination of the emotional tone is based on emotional dictionaries like GI (General Inquirer) and How Net. By comparing the accuracy and training time of different models, SVM is selected to be the optimal model with the F-scores of 82%.

articleTitle: Weakly Supervised Leaming of Discriminative Features for Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Fine-Grained Visual Categorization (FGVC) is one of challenging domains in computer vision due to the subtle differences between the subordinate categories which belong to one basic category. In order to solve this problem, recent FGVC methods could localize the discriminative regions firstly and then extract fine-grained features from these regions. However, it is difficult to mine consistent and adequate discriminative regions for final recognition. In this paper, a novel framework is proposed for FGVC which is composed of three branches which extract global features, discriminative fine-grained features and complementary fine-grained features, respectively. Concretely, discriminative fine-grained features are extracted through region from class activation map (CAM) method and complementary fine-grained features are extracted through regions from feature pyramid networks (FPN) assisted with algorithm to learn the rank of regions. Experimental results have shown that the proposed method achieve better performance than several state-of-the-art models on three datasets, such as CUB-200-2011, Stanford Cars and FGVC Aircraft.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Analog Signal Transmission by Digital Modulation System Based on SystemView
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In this Paper, the mathematical model of analog signal transmission through a digital modulation system is described. The analog continuous signal is transformed into digital baseband signal by source encoding technology. And the digital baseband signal becomes modulation signal through digital modulation technology since it is more suitable for channel transmission. The system model is designed and simulated by SystemView software, and finally the simulation results is analyzed from time domain and frequency domain.

articleTitle: Research on Hadoop-based Intrusion Detection by IP Address Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Regarding intrusion detection needed for web application security, we explored key technologies for intrusion detection respectively from perspectives of data collection, data pre-processing and Mahout data analysis. In this research, we present a logical architecture for intrusion detection by IP address mining based on massive log information, while putting forward the use of K-Means and FP-Growth algorithms in parallel on the Hadoop platform to detect intrusions and of Hive data warehouse to save the IP addresses of intruding machines. articleTitle: Research and Application of Data Mining Based on Artificial Intelligence in Cigarette Delivery
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Cigarette delivery strategy refers to the Tobacco Monopoly Bureau's delivery strategy for retail stores. Demand prediction is the premise of making precise delivery strategy. This paper studies the methods of demand prediction and cigarette delivery strategy based on artificial intelligence-based data mining. According to the current cigarette market demand, this paper studies the demand prediction model and makes intelligent delivery strategy for each kind of cigarette in the next delivery cycle. Finally realize the intelligence, digitization and precision in cigarette delivery.

articleTitle: Study on Input-Output Efficiency of Private Express Companies Based on DEA-Malmquist Index Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper takes the five private express listed companies in China as the research object, adopts the principal component analysis method and establishes the DEA-Malmquist index model to establish a comprehensive input-output index system, and measures the input-output efficiency of these five companies from 2017 to 2019. The results show that in the past three years, the input-output efficiency of these five companies have grown rapidly. However, there are problems of weak technical level, inconsistent production scale and R & D investment level. Finally, put forward relevant suggestions to help express companies optimize their structure and improve logistics efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Air-Ground Joint Debugging System of Flight Inspection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Flight inspection is an important method and means for verifying and evaluating whether the air signals of civil aviation communications, navigation, and surveillance equipment of flight procedures, are intact and effective or not. It is directly related to civil aviation flight safety. Flight inspection uses high-performance aircraft equipped with special flight inspection equipment to complete. During the inspection, the ground technician adjusts the ground navigation equipment based on the data reported by the flight inspector. This paper proposes to develop a flight inspection air-ground joint debugging system. After the inspection equipment on the aircraft obtains the navigation equipment signal, the signal parameters are sent to the ground flight inspection joint debugging system in a data format through the ground-air data link. The system automatically judges whether the parameters are normal or not, otherwise communicate with the navigation equipment according to the software preset instructions and adjust the parameters of the ground navigation equipment, and finally complete the flight inspection adjustment of the navigation equipment signals.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Transformation of Computer Remote Network Communication Technology in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, computer network communication technology has brought certain conveniences to the development of people and enterprises, and it has also broken through the traditional time and geographical limitations. However, under the influence of the big data era, China s computers There are still many problems in the development of long-distance network communication technology. The existence of these problems will not only affect the data transmission speed and quality, but also have a certain negative impact on people’s production and life. Therefore, in the context of the era of big data, relevant departments should revolutionize the network communication technology of the Computer College. This article describes the relative advantages and existing problems of computer remote network communication technology in the era of big data, and puts forward reasonable suggestions for computer network remote communication technology.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-target Automatic Localization of Inspection Robot Based on Adaptive Spatial Information in Unknown Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The current multi-target search and localization algorithms for robots rely on a pre-established multi-target automatic positioning model. When an unpredictable multi-target navigation plan is encountered during the robot inspection process, it is easy to cause misjudgment and identification. For multi-target positioning and tracking in the background environment, high-confidence models are extracted from unstable information sources as observations. Considering the timeliness of the search method, we propose a perceptual adaptive target search method using a sub-area search strategy. The adaptive search method designs a search track for the robot online, and divides the search area in the field of view into several sub-areas. When there are no targets in the sight range, you can use the sub-area search strategy to improve the search efficiency and ensure the effective implementation of target search and positioning tasks. Compared with other optimized trajectories designed off-line, it can ensure multi-target search purpose and avoid missing key information. Considering the threat of uncertain obstacles in an unknown environment, according to the principle of timeliness, an improved dynamic window method is applied to avoid obstacles. Finally, simulations verify the adaptive search ability of the above method. This algorithm can stably track multiple targets in complex scenes, effectively distinguish different targets, and has a good processing effect on target occlusion and background interference.

articleTitle: Research on the control system of the multi-point driving belt conveyor tension device
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The tensioning device is an important part of a large belt conveyor, and its performance is directly related to the safe operation and service life of the belt conveyor. This paper designs a hydraulic automatic tension device and electrical control scheme that provides the necessary tension for the conveyor to operate normally, establishes a multi-point drive belt conveyor tensioning device under different working conditions to establish a mathematical model, and uses MATLAB / SIMULINK to tension Simulate different systems under different operating conditions. The results show that the tensioning device can solve the key problems such as lagging dynamic load response to the conveyor belt and power imbalance in large conveyors under different working conditions. While reducing the use strength of the conveyor belt, the working efficiency of the belt conveyor is improved.

articleTitle: Thoughts On The Ecological Environment Management Innovation Driven By Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Based on the review of the technical characteristics and development process of big data, combined with the development trend of ecological environment big data, this paper puts forward the thinking of using big data to drive the innovation of ecological environment management and the countermeasures and suggestions for the intelligent application of ecological environment big data.

articleTitle: Research on Prevention and Control of Public Hospital Security Based on System Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Public hospitals are a barometer of social stability and are of great significance to social security. At present, the increasing maturity of new technologies such as big data, cloud computing and mobile Internet have provided new opportunities for the innovation and upgrading of the public security prevention and control system in hospital. Based on the system theory, this paper establishes a “1+4+5” PHs security prevention and control system. First, taking an information command center as the leader. Secondly, the campus border and access control network, key area control network, campus network space control network and video patrol control network are used as skeletons. Finally, five mechanisms including information sharing and early warning mechanism, linkage and coordination mechanism, emergency command mechanism, operation and maintenance support mechanism, and assessment and evaluation mechanism are used as guarantees. In order to comprehensively improve the information and intelligence level of the public security prevention and control system in public hospitals.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Potential Safety Hazards of Transmission Lines Based on Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Power transmission line safety monitoring is one of the important tasks to maintain the security of national power grid. In this paper, the object detection method based on computer vision is applied to automatically monitor the potential safety risk of transmission line. We firstly create a potential safety risk object dataset. Secondly we analyze most state-of-the-art object detection model. Thirdly according to the specific dataset, an object detection model was trained, which uses training tricks to get high performance. Fourthly, we built a monitoring system that feeds the discriminant results back to the display terminal, which can comprehensively grasp the situation of the whole safe area and ensure the safe operation of the transmission network. Our experiments show the excellent results are Cascade R-CNN detection framework based on deep learning and backbone based on high resolution representations network. It gains 81.5 mAP on 26 kinds of objects datasets at IOU threshold 0.5, and show hidden danger detection algorithm based on deep learning can accurately discriminate the dangerous sources. The monitoring system feeds the discriminant results back to the display terminal, which can comprehensively grasp the situation of the whole safe area and ensure the safe operation of the transmission network.

articleTitle: Using Big Data to Analyze Relationship between post-95 College Students’ Advanced Consumption View and Employment View
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The post-95 college students' have gradually entered the society and become an important force in employment and consumption. As the other side of the labor market - enterprises, it is necessary to understand the main force of the future labor market, that is, the employment concept of the post-95 generation, in order to better guide enterprise HR to carry out human resource management, and further increase efficiency for enterprises. This study starts with the post-95 college students' advanced consumption view and explores whether it has an impact on the post-95 college students' employment view, which is also conducive to the enterprise HR to better understand the post-95 college students' view of these aspects. Finally, this study finds that the post-95 college students' concept of advanced consumption and employment is significantly related.

articleTitle: Research on College English Teaching Model Assisted by Computer Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The development of new computer technologies such as new media technologie and the Internet has greatly promoted the reform of college English teaching. Today, Internet-based distance education has greatly optimized the environment for students to learn English. The development of it has established a more open teaching platform through emerging technologie such as the Internet, breaking through the unreasonable allocation of resources under the traditional teaching mode and promoting education. The booming development plays a vital role. This paper introduces the relationship between each subsystem and their functions and uses UML technology to model college English teaching systems.

articleTitle: Survey on Edge Computing Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet of Everything, emerging application scenarios including autonomous driving, immersive games based on VR or AR technology, and Industrial Internet of Things have promoted the early development of edge computing technologies. At present, the global mobile communications industry is moving towards 5G. Since 5G is one of the key access technologies to promote large-scale deployment of edge computing, it has made edge computing gain unprecedented attention in the world. However, since the birth of edge computing, edge computing security has been a key issue restricting its implementation and development. The new features of edge computing, the integration of a large number of new technologies, the new application scenarios brought by edge computing, and people's increasing demands for privacy protection have brought great challenges to edge computing security. This paper reviews the current research status of research on edge computing security. By analyzing the security challenges of edge computing in the context of new models, new application scenarios and new technology environments, this paper points out the security problems of edge computing in five aspects, including access control, key management, privacy protection, attack mitigation and anomaly detection. The paper separately discusses the research achievement of the academic community in these five areas and analyzes their advantages and disadvantages. Finally, combining edge cloud collaboration and edge intelligence, the future development direction of edge computing security is discussed and prospected.

articleTitle: Predicting Oil Production in Single Well using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Single well production prediction is an essential task for oilfield development planning and analysis. Existing methods used for such prediction suffer from a few problems. In particular, current methods do not consider large-scale data labeling or production prediction in different water cut phases. To this end, we propose to holistically use the static, historical data of a single well, such as its geological and production data to enable data labeling in different phases via our labelling tool. In addition, we use Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), a well-known Recurrent Neural Network, to build a predictive model for single-well production. The proposed model uses dominating features on well production and can train multiple wells together, which can generalize the application of the model. The model has also been fine-tuned to speed up training via the use of batch normalization. Compared with Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM), our proposed LSTM model demonstrates better prediction accuracy and strong generalization capability and thus lends itself nicely to single well production prediction in various water saturation phases.

articleTitle: Differential Privacy Information Publishing Algorithm based on Cluster Anonymity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, the attacker gets more and more complex background knowledge, which makes the anonymous model susceptible to background attack. Although the differential privacy model can resist the background attack, it reduces the versatility of the data. In this paper, this paper proposes a differential privacy information publishing algorithm based on clustering anonymity. The algorithm uses the cluster anonymous algorithm based on KD tree to cluster the original data sets and gets anonymous tables by anonymous operation. Finally, the algorithm adds noise to the anonymous table to satisfy the definition of differential privacy. The algorithm is compared with the DCMDP (Density-Based Clustering Mechanism with Differential Privacy, DCMDP) algorithm under different privacy budgets. The experiments show that as the privacy budget increases, the algorithm reduces the information loss by about 80% of the published data.

articleTitle: Review of Deep Learning Parallelization and Its Application in Spatial Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has achieved great success in the field of artificial intelligence. The rise of deep learning has accelerated the advent of the intelligent era. However, with the deepening of the layers of deep neural networks and the increasing complexity of algorithm models, the size of the data set used for training is also getting larger and larger, which causes the time required for training to continue to increase, and the parallelization of deep neural networks can effectively solve this problem. Therefore, the research on the parallelization of deep learning becomes more and more important. This article summarizes the current research status of deep learning and its parallelization implementation, and also introduces the related research progress in spatial data processing especially.

articleTitle: Technical Practice of Making Online Workplace Etiquette Courses Based on Camtasia Studio
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: With the emergence of the global new coronavirus pneumonia epidemic and the phenomenon of suspension of classes all over the world, how to make use of Internet technology and multimedia software to produce high-level online courses has become the key to improve the quality of teaching. The online course is an information-based teaching mode which has developed rapidly since the emergence of new pneumonia, and it is also an effective substitute for classroom teaching. It is not only suitable for the dissemination of knowledge in the era of mobile learning and the needs of personalized and in-depth learning, but also contains excellent teaching experience, teaching skills and teaching methods. However, the teaching of workplace etiquette has strong practical characteristics, how to effectively teach workplace etiquette on the Internet has become a major difficulty. The Internet has the advantages of openness, interaction and virtualization, and can disseminate the course contents in time and effectively. And the good use of multimedia course production tools and software, is conducive to the production of better quality multimedia course works, can enhance the online course effect. This article takes the etiquette teaching as the starting point, explores the online course production technology and practice under the new era background.

articleTitle: Research on the method of cross-cluster migration of bank’s massive valuable data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: This paper starts with the problems faced by the big data platform of a bank, and takes a large commercial bank as an example, analyzes the urgent security management problems that bank needs to solve, clarifies the tasks that different types of Hive tables need to be migrated across clusters, puts forward the methods of seamless migration of banking data across clusters and components, and then focuses on data migration across clusters. Finally, it summarizes the implementation process from the implementation effect and impact, and introduces a tool to improve the efficiency of data synchronization, which paves the way for the technical upgrading of commercial banks.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Airborne Weapon Combat Identification Simulation Test
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: In order to adapt to the new situation of the development of the new requirements, implement the system under the background of airborne weapons and equipment to carry out the evaluation test target, this paper puts forward the introduction of artificial intelligence technology. Through the research of of the application of artificial intelligence and usage pattern technology in airborne weapon combat identification simulation test, this paper set up the airborne weapon combat identification intelligent simulation test system. Carrying out the evaluation of airborne weapon's actual combat, this paper provide support for the evaluation of airborne weapon's performance and effectiveness under the typical combat background.

articleTitle: Pollution Transport Simulation and Machine-Learning Aided Source Detection in Metropolitan Areas
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Air pollution is one of the world's largest environmental health threats. This study aims to use simple remote signals to locate the source of a pollution release, which will significantly enhance our readiness to counter its threat. In urban areas, the flow structures advecting the pollution are extremely complex: boundary layer separation generates vortical structures that increase the spread of pollutants and break the plume into smaller patches by dispersion effect. Furthermore, the blocking and mixing in urban areas make it more obscured to locate the pollution sources. Flow structures were obtained by solving the two-dimensional NavierStokes equations using Computational Fluid Dynamics in a simplified scenario with imaginary urban architectures. We applied the canonical neural network to relate characteristics in the remote pollutant detector signals to the actual location of the pollutant release. The proposed algorithm identifies the source location and its uncertainty through a Monte Carlo analysis. When the number of training samples is small, as limited by the number of trial-releases we can perform in reality, data augmentation is done by introducing noisy measurement as new training samples. While the source localization is reasonable in the cross-flow direction, it is much harder to locate the streamwise location of the source due to signal similarity. The data augmentation technique we applied reduced the uncertainty of the source location by introducing under-fitting phenomena into the model. Furthermore, sensors away from the center line of the flow outperforms the ones near the center line, especially for detecting off-center sources. This indicates a pronounced effect of blocking and mixing right behind the building on the center line, which blurs sensor measurements from different source locations, and thus hinders the ability to trace back to the source.

articleTitle: Research and Optimization of Feature Selection Method for TMS Classification Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: Due to the expansion of data scale, the data in Transportation Management System (TMS) of the State Grid has the features of distributed storage, more data noise and larger data dimension, making data analysis extremely difficult. Therefore, data sorting and feature selection should be carried out on the basis of the original data for subsequent learning tasks. The optimization method of feature selection for TMS classification learning is able to effectively select a large number of features, thus improving the accuracy of classification learning. In order to train a feature selection model suitable for TMS, this paper studies the method of applying random forest model integrated by multiple decision trees to TMS feature selection. By comparing the number of decision trees, the criteria of feature classification, the maximum number of features in candidate subset of feature classification, and the change of model accuracy after feature rearrangement with key algorithms, a feature selection method most suitable for TMS data is given and verified by experiments. Experimental results show that the proposed optimization method of feature selection lays a good foundation for future learning tasks.

articleTitle: Preface - ICBAIE 2020
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering (ICBAIE)
abstract: The 2020 International Conference on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering（ICBAIE 2020) was successfully held on June 12, 2020. Although the world is still affected by COVID-19 and many cities are still under travel restriction, with the aim to fulfill the enthusiasm of experts to participate this conference, ICBAIE 2020 continued to be carried out through virtual conference according to original schedule instead of postponing it. ICBAIE 2020 aims to gather experts, scholars and practitioners in the field of Big Data, Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Engineering to discuss the latest trends, disseminate the advanced research and enhance their cooperation. ICBAIE 2020 was organized by Yango University, Spatial Data Mining and Application Engineering Research Center of Fujian Province University, and AEIC Academic Exchange Information Centre. We are honored to have Prof. Rongrong Ji, IEEE Senior Member, from Xiamen University to serve as our Conference Chair, while Prof. Wenzhong Guo from Fuzhou University, and Prof. Fenghua Huang from Yango University are invited to be Program Committee Chairs. The conference model was divided into two parts, including keynote presentations and online discussion. In the first part, each keynote speakers were allocated 30 minutes to present their talks via Zoom. After the keynote talks, all participants joined in a WeChat communication group to discuss more about the talks and presentations. In order to vividly present the achievement of this conference, we selected a bunch of high-quality papers submitted to the conference and compiled them into the proceedings after rigorously reviewed them. These papers feature following five categories but are not limited to: Big Data and Cloud Computing, Technologies and Application of Artificial Intelligence, Robotics Science and Engineering, Internet of Things and Sensor Technology, and Special Session：Intelligent Big Data Analysis and Applications. All the papers have been through rigorous review and process to meet the requirements of International publication standard.
